package usagestore

// Independent adversarial review r33 unit proofs for usagestore checkpoint
// commits produced by CheckpointForRestart (Event == nil, CloseEpoch == false,
// SampledAt == head.LastSample).
// TEST ONLY temp SQLite; no network or host state.

import (
	"bytes"
	"path/filepath"
	"reflect"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/TED-H-com/Freedom-VPN/pkg/decstr"
)

// TestR33_StoreUnchangedCheckpointPreservesLedgerAndDurability proves directly
// at the usagestore layer that a checkpoint-only Commit with Event == nil,
// CloseEpoch == false, and SampledAt == head.LastSample (the exact Commit plan
// constructed by planSampleWithBarrier when restart == true and readings are
// unchanged at now <= head.LastSample):
//   - runs inside a real SQLite write transaction (invoking StepCheckpoint,
//     StepBeforeCommit, and StepAfterCommit while skipping StepInsert),
//   - returns seq == 0,
//   - preserves OpenEpoch, OpenReason, LastCloseReason, HasHistory, BootID,
//     LastSample, Counters (including >2^53 byte values), NextSeq, AckedThrough,
//     LedgerEpoch, BlockedSeq, archived and pending outbox payloads/hashes,
//     ReadSnapshot, and OutboxStatus across close/reopen.
func TestR33_StoreUnchangedCheckpointPreservesLedgerAndDurability(t *testing.T) {
	t0 := time.Date(2026, 11, 4, 18, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	now := t0

	var steps []string
	recordSteps := false
	dbPath := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "usage.db")
	opt := Options{
		Now: func() time.Time { return now },
		Hook: func(step string) error {
			if recordSteps {
				steps = append(steps, step)
			}
			return nil
		},
	}
	s, err := Open(dbPath, testNode, testInc, opt)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer func() { _ = s.Close() }()

	const largeBytes uint64 = (1 << 53) + 7 // 9007199254740999
	cs0 := []Counter{
		counterAt(testDev, testMem, "download", 20, 4096, 1),
		counterAt(testDev, testMem, "upload", 10, largeBytes, 1),
	}
	epoch := openEpoch(t, s, cs0, t0)

	// Commit seq 1 at t0+10s and ACK it.
	now = t0.Add(10 * time.Second)
	cs1 := []Counter{
		counterAt(testDev, testMem, "download", 22, 4096+2000, 1),
		counterAt(testDev, testMem, "upload", 12, largeBytes+1000, 1),
	}
	seq1, err := s.Commit(t.Context(), Commit{
		Epoch:     epoch,
		Counters:  cs1,
		BootID:    "boot-1",
		SampledAt: now,
		Event: &Draft{
			EpochID: epoch,
			Start:   t0,
			End:     now,
			Quality: "complete",
			Records: []DraftRecord{
				{MemberID: testMem, DeviceID: testDev, BindingRevision: 1, PeriodID: "2026-11", Upload: 1000, Download: 2000},
			},
		},
	})
	if err != nil || seq1 != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("Commit seq 1: seq=%d err=%v", seq1, err)
	}
	if err := s.ApplyACK(t.Context(), BatchACK{
		Highest: 1,
		Results: []EventResult{{Seq: 1, Status: StatusAccepted}},
	}); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("ApplyACK(1): %v", err)
	}

	// Commit seq 2 at t0+20s (remains unacked in outbox).
	now = t0.Add(20 * time.Second)
	cs2 := []Counter{
		counterAt(testDev, testMem, "download", 25, 4096+3500, 1),
		counterAt(testDev, testMem, "upload", 15, largeBytes+2500, 1),
	}
	seq2, err := s.Commit(t.Context(), Commit{
		Epoch:     epoch,
		Counters:  cs2,
		BootID:    "boot-1",
		SampledAt: now,
		Event: &Draft{
			EpochID: epoch,
			Start:   t0.Add(10 * time.Second),
			End:     now,
			Quality: "complete",
			Records: []DraftRecord{
				{MemberID: testMem, DeviceID: testDev, BindingRevision: 1, PeriodID: "2026-11", Upload: 1500, Download: 1500},
			},
		},
	})
	if err != nil || seq2 != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("Commit seq 2: seq=%d err=%v", seq2, err)
	}

	headBefore, err := s.Head(t.Context())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	ev1Before, err := s.Event(t.Context(), 1)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	ev2Before, err := s.Event(t.Context(), 2)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	snapBefore, err := ReadSnapshot(t.Context(), dbPath)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	statusBefore, err := s.OutboxStatus(t.Context())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	// Execute the exact unchanged restart checkpoint Commit:
	// Epoch = headBefore.OpenEpoch, Counters = headBefore.Counters,
	// BootID = headBefore.BootID, SampledAt = headBefore.LastSample,
	// Event = nil, CloseEpoch = false.
	steps = nil
	recordSteps = true
	seqCkpt, err := s.Commit(t.Context(), Commit{
		Epoch:     headBefore.OpenEpoch,
		Counters:  headBefore.Counters,
		BootID:    headBefore.BootID,
		SampledAt: headBefore.LastSample,
	})
	recordSteps = false
	if err != nil || seqCkpt != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("unchanged restart checkpoint Commit: seq=%d err=%v, want 0/nil", seqCkpt, err)
	}
	wantSteps := []string{StepCheckpoint, StepBeforeCommit, StepAfterCommit}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(steps, wantSteps) {
		t.Fatalf("Commit steps=%v, want %v", steps, wantSteps)
	}

	// Reopen from disk and verify every durable structure matches headBefore.
	if err := s.Close(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	s2, err := Open(dbPath, testNode, testInc, Options{Now: func() time.Time { return now }})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer func() { _ = s2.Close() }()

	headAfter, err := s2.Head(t.Context())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(headAfter, headBefore) {
		t.Fatalf("Head changed after unchanged checkpoint:\ngot:  %+v\nwant: %+v", headAfter, headBefore)
	}
	// Verify >2^53 byte value round-trips through decstr without float loss.
	if decstr.U64(headAfter.Counters[1].Bytes).String() != "9007199254743499" {
		t.Fatalf("large counter bytes=%d, want 9007199254743499", headAfter.Counters[1].Bytes)
	}
	ev1After, err := s2.Event(t.Context(), 1)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	ev2After, err := s2.Event(t.Context(), 2)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if !bytes.Equal(ev1After.Payload, ev1Before.Payload) || ev1After.Hash != ev1Before.Hash || ev1After.State != "archived" {
		t.Fatalf("event 1 mutated: %+v", ev1After)
	}
	if !bytes.Equal(ev2After.Payload, ev2Before.Payload) || ev2After.Hash != ev2Before.Hash || ev2After.State != "outbox" {
		t.Fatalf("event 2 mutated: %+v", ev2After)
	}
	snapAfter, err := ReadSnapshot(t.Context(), dbPath)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(snapAfter, snapBefore) {
		t.Fatalf("ReadSnapshot changed: %+v vs %+v", snapAfter, snapBefore)
	}
	statusAfter, err := s2.OutboxStatus(t.Context())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if statusAfter.UnackedEventCount != statusBefore.UnackedEventCount || statusAfter.UnackedPayloadBytes != statusBefore.UnackedPayloadBytes || statusAfter.CentralAckedThrough != statusBefore.CentralAckedThrough {
		t.Fatalf("OutboxStatus changed: %+v vs %+v", statusAfter, statusBefore)
	}
}
